overview.description: AquaLuminus is a mobile UV water filtration and monitoring system designed to provide real-time water quality information and system insights. The system connects water-quality and filtration-related monitoring data with a software interface, allowing users to view collected sensor readings, monitor the status of the filtration process, and better understand the condition of the water through an accessible monitoring dashboard.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring
keyFeatures.description: Displays collected water-quality sensor readings through the application, giving users accessible information about the current condition of the monitored water.

keyFeatures.title: Water Quality Dashboard
keyFeatures.description: Presents water-quality information and monitoring data through a centralized dashboard designed to make changing readings easier to understand.

keyFeatures.title: UV Filtration Monitoring
keyFeatures.description: Provides monitoring information related to the UV filtration process and helps users observe the operational status of the filtration system.

keyFeatures.title: System Status & Insights
keyFeatures.description: Provides system-related information and operational insights to help users monitor the overall status of the filtration and monitoring components.

keyFeatures.title: Sensor Data Visualization
keyFeatures.description: Transforms collected sensor readings into understandable monitoring information within the application interface.

keyFeatures.title: Mobile-Friendly Interface
keyFeatures.description: Uses a responsive interface designed to make water-quality and filtration information accessible through a mobile-oriented monitoring experience.
